engine: 2026.11.11.0 Release x64; base 388d7e9 + local STRATEGY-003 density fix

entries.expected: r1 source-only archive opens as an independent r2 project and rebuilds on the exact local Runtime.
entries.actual: Fresh r2 project build validated and activated; baseline Editor Play reproduced r1 win, crate x=-1.80638, unit z=9.312, won=1/lost=0.

entries.expected: Right click intersects floor and produces a world-space movement goal; arrival stops the selected soldier.
entries.actual: RaycastCursor returned Hit at (-1.5125,-3.0125). Squad1 moved from z=-6 to -3.12003 and stayed there; moving=0 completed=1. HUD/D3D shows target marker and ready state.

entries.expected: Switching selection leaves other soldiers orders active; a new click replaces only the selected soldier destination.
entries.actual: Squad1 continued moving while Squad2 was selected and ordered. Squad1 destination changed from z=0.0125 to -3.975; both squads completed their separate goals. Pause held all positions for 30 frames; Resume advanced CorridorGuard.
After direct movement, telemetry is completed=0/cancelled=1; selected HUD reports cancellation. This fixed a game-code issue.
entries.expected: Manual WASD override cancels an existing order and HUD does not show stale completion.
Interactive HUD blocks commands; misses do not replace prior goal; floor commands still work after viewport resize.
entries.actual: At 320x480, floor directly under the HUD returned pointerBlocked=1/trace=InputBlocked and kept the previous target. Off-floor click returned Miss and preserved the target. After resize to 1000x720, click returned Hit at approximately x=1.497,z=-1.989 and the soldier reached it.

entries.expected: An order to the exit cannot cross the unopened physical gate; guard FSM can catch a stalled unit.
entries.actual: Unit stopped at z=1.104, guard transitioned Patrol→Chase, outcome lost=1.

entries.expected: Click exit immediately after applying crate impulse and win.
entries.actual: The direct route is tactically unsafe at this timing: guard caught the soldier at z=2.16 (lost=1). The character kept executing its order after the loss flag and reached z=9.36; this visual crossing is not a win. No Engine defect is claimed.

entries.expected: Clear the crate, let it stop at the physical bumper, then issue a floor-click order to the exit; guard FSM remains consequential.
entries.actual: Crate remained at x=-1.80638, Squad1 reached z=9.552, guard state Chase, won=1/lost=0. After 55 frames between E and the order, the timing created a viable route without changing guard speed or perception.

entries.expected: Source-only archive extracts to a clean directory, rebuilds and repeats actual Editor Play victory.
entries.actual: RepairCorridorFresh build log reports validated+activated; real project.input Editor Play repeated won=1/lost=0. ZIP has 15 source/project files and no DLL/LIB/PDB/object binaries.

entries.expected: Fresh archive build loads custom Game and advances in standalone Runtime.
entries.actual: EngineRuntime --mode game --frames 40 logged GameUpdates=40, EngineStopped, exit=0; telemetry has game objects, target slots, CorridorGuard Patrol.

entries.expected: Inspect and edit the tactical map in Edit mode.
entries.actual: Main.scene.json remains empty; the gameplay corridor is procedurally generated during Play. Edit authoring/visual review of the tactical scene is not implemented.

Initial build failed with C2065 because telemetry referenced local input out of scope. Game code moved the state to ProjectGame; subsequent explicit Runtime builds validated and activated. Not an Engine defect.
entries.expected: Preserve project compile diagnostics and rebuild the corrected game module.
